_comment: Row 660: a gate ran the REGENERATION chain while merely checking. One mutant per CODE seam -- the chain-skip DECISION, the read-only/write refusal DECISION, and the verifier DENOMINATOR that read-only mode must still judge -- all MUST be CAUGHT. The third seam, the detector argv in FOOTGUNS.json, carries NO mutant on purpose: test_row357 refuses a value-bearing anchor there and no producer record establishes its class. That seam is covered by assertion instead -- test_row660_the_census_detector_does_not_run_the_regeneration_chain reads the argv out of FOOTGUNS.json rather than retyping it, so dropping --check from the detector fails that test.
subject: bd-regen-order --check is read-only, and the FOOTGUNS detector asks for it
